expectations.note: The candidate launched the Linux debug app and used the live ext.nothingness drive surface; my verification answered with runtime state and a populated queue.
Independent runtime captures showed playback true, then false after pause, then true after resume, matching the candidate's transition report.
With a three-track queue, my before/after captures showed next changing currentIndex 0 to 1 and the active path from track 01 to track 02, corroborating the candidate's skip.
A live seek performed while playing moved the same track from 10.469 seconds to 30.511 seconds; the post-seek position is within the requested 30-second tolerance.
The candidate's play/pause/resume and skip claims have concrete state reads, but its 30-second and 45-second seek entries report command acknowledgements without a post-seek position read.
The live smoke behavior was normal and the collected git inspection reported empty status and diff, with no candidate source changes.
The candidate recovered from its shell parsing/read errors by retrying state reads; the app remained responsive and my runtime capture showed zero overflow reports.
